I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: token
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Token to use for ArcGIS REST API requests

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: attribution
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The attribution to display with the data.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: name
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of the catalog item.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: description
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, then no generic default description will be displayed if description is undefined.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: nameInCatalog
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of the item to be displayed in the catalog, if it is different from the one to display in the workbench.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: info
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Human-readable information about this dataset.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: infoSectionOrder
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReport
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReportSections
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: isExperiencingIssues
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: hideSource
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: metadataUrls
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: dataUrls
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: dataCustodian
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: modelDimensions
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: disableAboutData
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: shareable
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: options
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Additional options to pass to Cesium's Cesium3DTileset constructor.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: style
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The style to use, specified according to the Cesium 3D Tiles Styling Language.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: filters
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The filters to apply to this catalog item.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: colorBlendMode
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The color blend mode decides how per-feature color is blended with color defined in the tileset. Acceptable values are HIGHLIGHT, MIX & REPLACE as defined in the cesium documentation - https://cesium.com/docs/cesiumjs-ref-doc/Cesium3DTileColorBlendMode.html

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: colorBlendAmount
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: When the colorBlendMode is MIX this value is used to interpolate between source color and feature color. A value of 0.0 results in the source color while a value of 1.0 results in the feature color, with any value in-between resulting in a mix of the source color and feature color.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: featureIdProperties
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: One or many properties of a feature that together identify it uniquely. This is useful for setting properties for individual features. eg: ['lat', 'lon'], ['buildingId'] etc.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: lightColor
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The light color when shading models. When undefined the scene's light color is used instead. eg: [255, 255, 255].

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: drapeImagery
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: When true allows draping imagery on top of this tileset. Imagery items appearing above this catalog item in the workbench will be draped on top of the tileset.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: ionAssetId
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The Cesium ion asset id. If this is set then the url is ignored

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: ionAccessToken
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Cesium ion access token. If not specified, the default token is used.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: ionServer
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: URL of the Cesium ion API server. If not specified, the default Ion server, https://api.cesium.com/, is used.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: clippingPlanes
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The ClippingPlaneCollection used to selectively disable rendering the tileset.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: clippingBox
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Defines a user controllable clipping box used to hide or show sections of a model.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: featureInfoUrlTemplate
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: A template URL string for fetching feature info. Template values of the form {x} will be replaced with corresponding property values from the picked feature.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: maxRequests
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Max number of feature info requests to send to API url. Keep this number small to avoid sending to many requests to server (default 10).

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: allowFeaturePicking
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Indicates whether features in this catalog item can be selected by clicking them on the map.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: highlightColor
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The color used to highlight a feature when it is picked. If not set, this defaults to Terria.baseMapContrastColor

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: terrainURL
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: URL to construct ArcGISTiledElevationTerrainProvider for I3S geometry.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: lightingFactor
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Cartesian2 of lighting factor for imageBasedLightingFactor

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: keepOnTop
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Keeps the layer on top of all other imagery layers.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: supportsReordering
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Does this layer support reordering in the workbench.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: legends
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The legends to display on the workbench.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: legendBackgroundColor
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Apply background color to all legends. This can be useful if legends are transparent and clash with Terria colours

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: hideLegendInWorkbench
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the legend is hidden in the workbench for this catalog member.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: rectangle
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The bounding box rectangle that contains all the data in this catalog item.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: idealZoom
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Override default ideal zoom if the given values are valid.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: disablePreview
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the preview on the Add Data panel. This is useful when the preview will be very slow to load.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: disableZoomTo
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the zoom to (aka 'Ideal Zoom') button in the workbench.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: zoomOnAddToWorkbench
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Zoom to dataset when added to workbench. Doesn't work if disableZoomTo is true.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: show
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Show or hide a workbench item. When show is false, a mappable item is removed from the map and a chartable item is removed from the chart panel.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: initialMessage
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: A message to show when the user adds the catalog item to the workbench. Useful for showing disclaimers.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: featureInfoTemplate
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: A template object for formatting content in feature info panel

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: showStringIfPropertyValueIsNull
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: If the value of a property is null or undefined, show the specified string as the value of the property. Otherwise, the property name will not be listed at all.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: maximumShownFeatureInfos
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The maximum number of "feature infos" that can be displayed in feature info panel.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: preferredViewerMode
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The preferred viewer mode for this item - either '2d' '3d' or '3dsmooth'. If this dataset is used as a basemap then we automatically switch the viewer to the preferred mode. However the user can still switch to another mode, so this preference is not strongly enforced.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: opacity
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The opacity of the item.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: disableOpacityControl
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: When true, the user will be unable to change the opacity of the item

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: editing
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Editor traits

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: search
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Item search configuration

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: shadows
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Determines whether the tileset casts or receives shadows from each light source.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: showShadowUi
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Determines whether the shadow UI component will be shown on the workbench item

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: splitDirection
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The side of the splitter to display this imagery layer on. Defaults to both sides.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: disableSplitter
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, splitter funcitonality will be hidden for this model.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: origin
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The origin of the model, expressed as a longitude and latitude in degrees and a height in meters. If this property is specified, the model's axes will have X pointing East, Y pointing North, and Z pointing Up. If not specified, the model is located in the Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed frame.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: rotation
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The rotation of the model expressed as heading, pitch and roll in the local frame of reference. Defaults to zero rotation.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: scale
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The scale factor to apply to the model

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: url
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: forceProxy
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

I3SCatalogItemTraits.name: cacheDuration
I3SCatalogItemTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

InfoSectionTraits.name: content
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section, in Markdown and HTML format. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: url
MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL

DataUrlTraits.name: url
DataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

DataUrlTraits.name: title
DataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DimensionOptionTraits.name: value
DimensionOptionTraits.description: Value (if this is undefined, id will be used)

OptionsTraits.name: maximumScreenSpaceError
OptionsTraits.description: The maximum screen space error used to drive level of detail refinement.

OptionsTraits.name: showCreditsOnScreen
OptionsTraits.description: Whether to display the credits of this tileset on screen.

OptionsTraits.name: asynchronouslyLoadImagery
OptionsTraits.description: When true, Cesium does not wait for the draped imagery layers to load before the tileset mesh is rendered. This means while the imagery is being loaded the original tile texture will be shown.

OptionsTraits.name: dynamicScreenSpaceErrorDensity
OptionsTraits.description: Density used to adjust the dynamic screen space error, similar to fog density.

OptionsTraits.name: dynamicScreenSpaceErrorFactor
OptionsTraits.description: A factor used to increase the screen space error of tiles for the dynamic screen space error optimization.

OptionsTraits.name: dynamicScreenSpaceErrorHeightFalloff
OptionsTraits.description: A ratio of the tileset's height that determines the height at which the dynamic screen space error optimization has the maximum effect.

OptionsTraits.name: cacheBytes
OptionsTraits.description: The size (in bytes) to which the tile cache will be trimmed if not needed for the current view. This is the modern replacement for the now-removed maximumNumberOfLoadedTiles option.

OptionsTraits.name: maximumCacheOverflowBytes
OptionsTraits.description: The maximum additional memory (in bytes) to allow for cache headroom, if more than cacheBytes are needed for the current view.

OptionsTraits.name: skipLevelOfDetail
OptionsTraits.description: Optimization option. Determines if level of detail skipping should be applied during the tileset traversal, allowing the renderer to skip levels of the tree rather than always refining one level at a time. Not tied to the quality slider - this is a traversal-algorithm choice, not a fidelity trade-off, so enabling it should generally help regardless of the current quality tier.

OptionsTraits.name: baseScreenSpaceError
OptionsTraits.description: The screen space error that must be reached before skipping levels of detail. Only used when skipLevelOfDetail is true.

OptionsTraits.name: skipScreenSpaceErrorFactor
OptionsTraits.description: Defines how much must the screen space error be improved before a tile is no longer skipped in the level-of-detail traversal. Only used when skipLevelOfDetail is true.

OptionsTraits.name: skipLevels
OptionsTraits.description: The minimum number of levels to skip when loading tiles during the level-of-detail traversal. Only used when skipLevelOfDetail is true.

OptionsTraits.name: immediatelyLoadDesiredLevelOfDetail
OptionsTraits.description: Determines whether the tileset should load the desired level of detail immediately, bypassing the level-of-detail skipping optimization entirely, trading more upfront bandwidth for reaching full detail faster. Only used when skipLevelOfDetail is true.

OptionsTraits.name: loadSiblings
OptionsTraits.description: Determines whether siblings of visible tiles are always downloaded during traversal, so panning to reveal them doesn't need a fresh request. Only has an effect when skipLevelOfDetail is true - setting it on a dataset that doesn't also enable skipLevelOfDetail will silently do nothing.

OptionsTraits.name: cullRequestsWhileMoving
OptionsTraits.description: Optimization option. Don't request tiles that will likely be unused when they come back because the camera is moving. Already defaults to true in Cesium; expose here for the rare dataset that needs different behaviour.

OptionsTraits.name: cullRequestsWhileMovingMultiplier
OptionsTraits.description: Optimization option. Multiplier used in culling requests while moving. Larger is more aggressive culling, smaller less aggressive culling.

OptionsTraits.name: preloadWhenHidden
OptionsTraits.description: Preload tiles when tileset.show is false. Loads tiles as if the tileset is visible but does not render them.

OptionsTraits.name: cullWithChildrenBounds
OptionsTraits.description: Optimization option. Whether to cull tiles using the union of their children bounding volumes. Note: this is only read once, when the tileset is first created - it cannot be changed on an already-loaded tileset without reloading it.

PointCloudShadingTraits.name: attenuation
PointCloudShadingTraits.description: Perform point attenuation based on geometric error.

PointCloudShadingTraits.name: geometricErrorScale
PointCloudShadingTraits.description: Scale to be applied to each tile's geometric error.

FilterTraits.name: property
FilterTraits.description: The name of the feature property to filter

FilterTraits.name: minimumShown
FilterTraits.description: The lowest value the property can have if it is to be shown

FilterTraits.name: maximumShown
FilterTraits.description: The largest value the property can have if it is to be shown

ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.name: enabled
ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.description: Determines whether the clipping planes are active.

ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.name: unionClippingRegions
ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.description: If true, a region will be clipped if it is on the outside of any plane in the collection. Otherwise, a region will only be clipped if it is on the outside of every plane.

ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.name: edgeWidth
ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.description: The width, in pixels, of the highlight applied to the edge along which an object is clipped.

ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.name: edgeColor
ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.description: The color applied to highlight the edge along which an object is clipped.

ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.name: planes
ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.description: An array of ClippingPlane objects used to selectively disable rendering on the outside of each plane.

ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.name: modelMatrix
ClippingPlaneCollectionTraits.description: The 4x4 transformation matrix specifying an additional transform relative to the clipping planes original coordinate system.

ClippingPlaneDefinitionTraits.name: distance
ClippingPlaneDefinitionTraits.description: The shortest distance from the origin to the plane. The sign of distance determines which side of the plane the origin is on. If distance is positive, the origin is in the half-space in the direction of the normal; if negative, the origin is in the half-space opposite to the normal; if zero, the plane passes through the origin.

ClippingBoxTraits.name: position
ClippingBoxTraits.description: Latitude, longitude and height of the clipping box. When not set, the box is positioned at the center of the screen.

ClippingBoxTraits.name: enableFeature
ClippingBoxTraits.description: Set false to completely disable clipping box feature for the item.

ClippingBoxTraits.name: showClippingBox
ClippingBoxTraits.description: Shows a 3D box and associated UI for editing the clip volume.

ClippingBoxTraits.name: keepBoxAboveGround
ClippingBoxTraits.description: When true, prevents the box from going underground.

ClippingBoxTraits.name: dimensions
ClippingBoxTraits.description: The length, width and height of the clipping box. When not set, the box will be 1/3rd the screen size.

ClippingBoxTraits.name: clipDirection
ClippingBoxTraits.description: Whether to clip the model outside of the box or inside. When this value is "outside", everything outside the box is clipped and when the value is "inside", everything inside the box is clipped. Default value is "inside"

ClippingBoxTraits.name: size
ClippingBoxTraits.description: Length, width and height of the box

ClippingBoxTraits.name: rotation
ClippingBoxTraits.description: Rotation specified as heading, pitch and roll in degrees.

ClippingBoxDimensionTraits.name: length
ClippingBoxDimensionTraits.description: Length of the clipping box (along the x-axis).

ClippingBoxDimensionTraits.name: width
ClippingBoxDimensionTraits.description: Width of the clipping box (along the y-axis).

CornerPointsStyleTraits.name: pixelSize
CornerPointsStyleTraits.description: Pixel size of the corner point

CornerPointsStyleTraits.name: color
CornerPointsStyleTraits.description: Corner point color. Can be any valid CSS color string.

LegendTraits.name: title
LegendTraits.description: A title to be displayed above the legend.

LegendTraits.name: url
LegendTraits.description: The URL of the legend image. If the URL suffix isn't one of the following png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg, then urlMimeType must be defined - otherwise a hyperlink will be shown.

LegendTraits.name: imageScaling
LegendTraits.description: Scaling of the legend. For example, a high DPI legend may have scaling = 0.5, so it will be scaled down 50%

LegendTraits.name: urlMimeType
LegendTraits.description: The MIME type of the URL legend image. For example "image/png"

LegendTraits.name: backgroundColor
LegendTraits.description: Apply background color to entire legend. This can be useful if legend is transparent and clashes with Terria colours. This will override legendBackgroundColor.

LegendItemTraits.name: title
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleTitles
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple titles to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: maxMultipleTitlesShowed
LegendItemTraits.description: Maximum number of multiple titles to display next to this legend item. (Default is 10)

LegendItemTraits.name: titleAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display above this legend item, i.e. marking the top of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: titleBelow
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display below this legend item, i.e. marking the bottom of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: color
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color to display for this item. This property is ignored if Legend URL is specified.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineColor
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color with which to outline this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of outline in pixels

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineStyle
LegendItemTraits.description: The style of outline using CSS outline-style values. Eg 'dotted', 'dashed', 'solid', 'double', 'groove', 'ridge', 'inset', 'outset'

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleColors
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple colors to show with this item in a grid arrangement.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageUrl
LegendItemTraits.description: The URL of an image to display with this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: marker
LegendItemTraits.description: Maki marker ID to display with this item (eg "circle").

LegendItemTraits.name: rotation
LegendItemTraits.description: The degrees to rotate legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: addSpacingAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: True to add a bit of extra spacing above this item in order to separate it visually from the rest of the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageHeight
LegendItemTraits.description: The height of the legend image.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of the legend image.

RectangleTraits.name: position
RectangleTraits.description: Position of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame in meters.

RectangleTraits.name: direction
RectangleTraits.description: The look direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

RectangleTraits.name: up
RectangleTraits.description: The up vector direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

VectorTraits.name: x
VectorTraits.description: X component of vector in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

VectorTraits.name: y
VectorTraits.description: Y component of vector in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

VectorTraits.name: z
VectorTraits.description: Z component of vector in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

IdealZoomTraits.name: lookAt
IdealZoomTraits.description: Parameters for camera to look at a target.

IdealZoomTraits.name: camera
IdealZoomTraits.description: Use camera position, direction and up if fully defined. Otherwise use rectangle if fully defined.

LookAtTraits.name: targetLongitude
LookAtTraits.description: Target longitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid in degrees

LookAtTraits.name: targetLatitude
LookAtTraits.description: Target latitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid in degrees

LookAtTraits.name: targetHeight
LookAtTraits.description: Target height in meters. Treat it as camera height. A positive value is above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Default to 100 meters.

LookAtTraits.name: heading
LookAtTraits.description: Heading in degrees. Treat it as camera bearing. North is 0. A positive value rotates clockwise, negative anti-clockwise. Default to 0.

LookAtTraits.name: pitch
LookAtTraits.description: Pitch in degrees. Treat it as camera pitch. A positive value is to look down, negative up. Default to 45.

LookAtTraits.name: range
LookAtTraits.description: The range in meters. It is the distance between the target position and camera position projected onto the local plane. Not negative and default to 500.

CameraTraits.name: position
CameraTraits.description: Position of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame in meters.

CameraTraits.name: direction
CameraTraits.description: The look direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

CameraTraits.name: up
CameraTraits.description: The up vector direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

InitialMessageTraits.name: key
InitialMessageTraits.description: Identifier. If multiple messages with the same key are triggered, only the first will be displayed.

InitialMessageTraits.name: confirmText
InitialMessageTraits.description: If confirmation is true, the text to put on the confirmation button.

InitialMessageTraits.name: showAsToast
InitialMessageTraits.description: Show the initial message as a toast

InitialMessageTraits.name: toastVisibleDuration
InitialMessageTraits.description: Time in seconds after which the toast will be dismissed. If undefined, user must take action.

FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.name: name
FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.description: A mustache template string for formatting name

FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.name: template
FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.description: A Mustache template string for formatting description

FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.name: showFeatureInfoDownloadWithTemplate
FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.description: Show feature info download if a template has been provided. If no template is provided, then download will always show.

FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.name: partials
FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.description: An object, mapping partial names to a template string. Defines the partials used in Template.

FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.name: formats
FeatureInfoTemplateTraits.description: An object, mapping field names to formatting options.

EditorTraits.name: isEditable
EditorTraits.description: Indicates whether we can edit some aspect of the model item like its visibility or color

EditorTraits.name: isTransformable
EditorTraits.description: Indicates whether we can rotate/translate/scale the model

ItemSearchTraits.name: providerType
ItemSearchTraits.description: The type of the search provider.

ItemSearchTraits.name: resultTemplate
ItemSearchTraits.description: Template string to format the item result. You can pass a mustache template and refer to variables in {@ItemSearchResult.properties}. The template can also have HTML markup or markdown formatting.

ItemSearchTraits.name: highlightColor
ItemSearchTraits.description: A color to use for highlighting the selected result. Defaults to {@HighlightColorTraits.highlightColor} or {@Terria.baseMapContrastColor}

SearchParameterTraits.name: name
SearchParameterTraits.description: A human readable name for the search parameter

SearchParameterTraits.name: queryOptions
SearchParameterTraits.description: Options used when querying the parameter, these options will be passed to the index used for querying the parameter.
